title: Column header
description: An indigo gradient announcement strip over a light, borderless 62px nav: wordmark left, four centred links with small chevrons, a quiet sign-in link and a white ringed button with a chevron. The nav is sticky and slides away while you scroll down, coming back as soon as you scroll up. Phones get a burger that opens a stacked menu.
notes: needs JavaScript for the burger menu and the hide-on-scroll (hydrate: load)
